tagline: Track what each record is worth
summary: A single list of records, each with a category, a price and a quantity; see what a record is worth, mark one settled, and total the value still open.

stats.label: Open value
stats.rule: sum of Value where Settled is false

journeys.title: adds a record and shows its price
journeys.steps: Add a record with Name, Category 'Household', Price '40' and Quantity '1'; save
journeys.expect: The record is listed with its price

journeys.title: rejects an empty required field
journeys.steps: Add a record with Name blank; save
journeys.expect: The form shows 'Name is required.' and nothing is added

journeys.title: edits the price of a record
journeys.steps: Edit a record and change Price to '35'; save
journeys.expect: The record shows the new price

journeys.title: deletes a record
journeys.expect: The record is no longer listed

journeys.title: marks a record settled
journeys.steps: Use Mark settled on a record

journeys.title: filters to the open records
journeys.expect: Only records that are not settled are listed

journeys.title: totals the value still open
journeys.expect: The stat sums the value of every record that is not settled

journeys.title: preserves records across a browser refresh
journeys.steps: Add a record; refresh the browser
journeys.expect: The record is still listed with the same values

omitted_patterns.reason: The idea tracks amounts only, never a payment

assumptions: Prices are in £ and may have decimals
A record's value is its quantity times its price
